The '''Republic University''' was a [[University/Legends|university]] located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Some time prior to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] [[Trachta]] attended [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] lecture on political science there.
